source_excerpts.text:
For the unchanged recurrent-tree interaction, let Q(beta,tau) be the unassisted no-feedback reliable quantum communication rate in qubits per forward call, with fixed normal independent initial bath state tau. The separately reconstructed lower and new upper give

\[
\frac{\ln2}{2^{20}}\,\beta^2
\le Q(\beta,\tau)-\frac32
\le\frac12\log_2(1+\beta^2/4),
\qquad 0<\beta\le1/32.
\]

Thus the excess is **Theta(beta squared)**. This settles the small-gain order left open in the pinned model. The upper proof controls the complete channel, including its root and infinite bath, through a global completely positive comparison. It does not infer capacity from a few finite simulations or an individual spectral block.

Further reviewed results strengthen the resource accounting. At beta=0, an upper threshold of 1.5 survives arbitrary normal horizon-dependent initial bath–laboratory entanglement and backward quantum feedback, provided the fresh logical message is independent of that initial resource. A reviewed strong-converse bound forces Bell fidelity to vanish even at nominal rate 1.5. At nonzero beta, arbitrary initial resources have a separately proved quadratic weak ceiling; strong-converse transfers have their own fixed-resource or delayed-output hypotheses. These quantifiers must remain distinct.

Why this matters: it identifies the real scale of the model's memory-assisted communication gain and prevents hidden initial entanglement or feedback from being credited as a new forward resource. It is a foundational result about a specified channel. The actual interaction, calibration, useful coherence, finite-cost coding advantage and physical implementation remain unacquired. No energy or civilisation-level benefit follows directly from its capacity formula.

Evidence: [upper proof](/Users/harjas/Documents/Codex/2026-10-23/astra-civilisation-changing-discovery-with-35-2/outputs/proofs/RECURRENT_QUADRATIC_UPPER.txt), [root reconstruction](/Users/harjas/Documents/Codex/2026-10-23/astra-civilisation-changing-discovery-with-35-2/outputs/proofs/ROOT_RECURRENT_RECONSTRUCTION.md), [independent reconstruction](/Users/harjas/Documents/Codex/2026-10-23/astra-civilisation-changing-discovery-with-35-2/outputs/reviews/RECURRENT_INDEPENDENT_RECONSTRUCTION.md), and the source-bound extensions in CLAIM_LEDGER.json.
